fieldValues.title: A repository's indexes go stale unless a script rebuilds them
fieldValues.statement: When I give an agent a repository of a few hundred records through a connector, it needs ways in: by topic, by kind of record, by category and by time, and from any record to what is near it. SRS has no index that keeps itself current. So I write index notes and derived tags (a topic tag on everything a storyline reaches, a month tag from each date, a category tag from each relation) with a script, and run it on a timer. Between runs the indexes are wrong; when an agent files a record without the tags it is invisible to the queries; the index notes duplicate the records and can disagree with them; and the navigation outline grows past what an agent can read in one call.
source_ref: srs-programme: vignette 'an MCP agent must locate and cross-reference each thread…' (conversation 2026-11-21 · Auto indexes, learned from a private repository)
